title: Demandbase Review (2026)
intro: Demandbase is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — Enterprise account-based experience platform (Demandbase One) that unifies account intelligence, buying signals, advertising, and sales/marketing orchestration for B2B revenue teams. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Demandbase when enterprise account-based orchestration (data + engagement + ABM) is the buying job and you can run a custom-quote evaluation.
verdict: Choose Demandbase when enterprise account-based orchestration (data + engagement + ABM) is the buying job and you can run a custom-quote evaluation. Compare 6sense for predictive ABM peers, ZoomInfo for deeper contact databases, and Apollo for self-serve data+engagement. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Demandbase documents account and people intelligence inside Demandbase One, but it is primarily an ABX/ABM orchestration platform rather than a pure contact-database specialist.
Account identification, intent, and sales play prioritization are core — strong for account-based prospecting, not SMB people-search UX.
Firmographic, technographic, and intent enrichment of target accounts is central to the Demandbase One data story.
Outreach is mostly via integrated sales engagement and marketing channels; native email sequencing is limited — score reflects orchestration assist, not sequencer depth.
Native Salesforce/HubSpot/MAP connectors are first-party strengths for enterprise ABM stacks.
Enterprise ABX configuration, advertising, and data ops raise complexity versus self-serve SI tools.
Account engagement, pipeline, and ABM performance reporting are positioned as first-class for enterprise buyers.
Opaque custom packaging and enterprise scope hold the score down for price-sensitive buyers; justified when full ABX programs are in scope.

faq.question: Is Demandbase a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Demandbase is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use Demandbase for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.

faq.question: How is Demandbase priced?
faq.answer: Demandbase One is custom-quote enterprise packaging. No published seat dollar prices on demandbase.com/pricing. Confirm current modules with Demandbase.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Demandbase?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
